title: Bidirectional Spiral Field — O-Centered Axial Expansion, Layers & Terrain
status: canonical project geometry + explicit mathematical boundary
purpose: Define the O-centered double-spiral geometry shared by Axis, Plane, Mountain, Swamp, Tree, Root, Garden, Drain, Ring/Spiral recurrence and layered state-space projections without replacing the canonical two-circle Vesica.
invariants: O is the waist/origin of the project double-spiral field.
Axis supplies signed axial coordinate z; Plane supplies a section/frame, with the canonical waist section Sigma_0 at z=0.
Upper and lower branches may widen with increasing |z| while remaining one O-centered field.
Radial widening measures modeled scope/amplitude/horizon, not moral value or truth rank.
Mountain, Swamp, Garden, Drain, Tree and Root are overlays/regimes/routes within the field, not synonyms for the spiral curves.
The bidirectional spiral field supplements the Vesica projection; it does not replace Source Field, Manifestation Field, Door or the two-circle construction.
Chirality is a projection/model parameter, not a good/evil axis.
Exact logarithmic/golden geometry and origin-inclusive project geometry must remain distinguished.

coordinates.sign_convention: +z source/integration-facing; -z manifestation/depth-facing in the default projection
coordinates.firewall: Signed z is directional only. Project route classification still depends on state change, agency, evidence, Fruit, exit and return.

exact_logarithmic_pair.upper: gamma_+(t)=(r0 exp(bt) cos(t), r0 exp(bt) sin(t), +h t), t>=0
exact_logarithmic_pair.lower: gamma_-(t)=(r0 exp(bt) cos(s t+delta), r0 exp(bt) sin(s t+delta), -h t), t>=0
exact_logarithmic_pair.chirality_parameter: s=-1 gives mirrored handedness; s=+1 gives same handedness
exact_logarithmic_pair.boundary: Because r0 exp(bt)>0, exact logarithmic spirals do not pass through O; r0 is a finite center aperture/reference radius.

origin_inclusive_project_pair.lower: Gamma_-(t)=(R(t) cos(s t+delta), R(t) sin(s t+delta), -h t)
origin_inclusive_project_pair.axial_form: rho(z)=r0(exp(kappa*|z|)-1), with kappa=b/h when z=±h t
origin_inclusive_project_pair.boundary: This shifted radial law is a project construction inspired by logarithmic growth; it is not itself the exact logarithmic spiral.

layer_family.meaning: Discrete rings/disks are readable layer markers sampled from a continuous field; they are not additional realms.

envelope.shape: double-flared / hourglass / paired-horn envelope around Axis
envelope.waist: rho_max(0)=0 in the origin-inclusive project view
envelope.optional_door_aperture: For a nonzero waist aperture use rho_max(z)=a+r0(exp(kappa*|z|)-1), a>=0.
envelope.relation_to_vesica: When rendered inside the canonical two-circle Potato, the envelope can be clipped or normalized to the Source/Manifestation fields; it is a state-space/development overlay, not a new outer cosmology.

mountain.relation_to_radius: Mountain can narrow toward a summit while spiral radius widens because they encode different variables: convergence/integration versus lateral scope/amplitude.
tests: compression of many paths into coherent criterion

garden.coordinate_role: generative upper regime distributed across +z sections
garden.relation_to_radius: Wider upper sections can host more differentiated viable branches, Rooms, relations and Fruit.
garden.not: proof that larger radius is morally higher

tree.coordinate_role: organic branching route through the field
tree.mapping: trunk near O/Axis; branches spread across progressively wider upper sections; Fruit/Seed can return toward Plane/World.

swamp.relation_to_radius: Wider lower sections can represent broader recurrence, coupling, unresolved residue and role entanglement.
swamp.not: the lower spiral itself or all of Below

drain.coordinate_role: local inward/capture attractor inside lower field
drain.relation_to_radius: Drain can narrow even while the surrounding Swamp/spiral horizon widens; capture and scope are independent variables.

root.coordinate_role: provenance/support network across -z and current-state interfaces
root.mapping: roots may spread laterally through lower sections while retaining routes back to O/current structure.

motion_modes.meaning: widening depth/context, rooting or entanglement depending route
Fruit/knowledge returns toward a common Plane/World interface
provenance/root material is metabolized back into the operative present

field_reading.vertical: z = source↔manifestation/depth orientation under the current projection
field_reading.radial: rho = modeled relational/state-space horizon, amplitude or differentiation scope
field_reading.chirality: sign of angular progression = handedness only
field_reading.time: t or crossing order = history parameter; not identical with z
field_reading.state: additional variables may coexist orthogonally; the field is a visualization of selected coordinates, not the total ontology

relation_to_plane.canonical_plane: Sigma_0 is the waist/current section in the default drawing.
relation_to_plane.movable_sections: Other Sigma_z sections may be sampled for analysis; Plane remains frame-relative.
relation_to_plane.recurrence: Comparable crossings can be sampled at the same section or across declared layer families.
relation_to_plane.cross_sign: A lateral diameter of Sigma_0 plus Axis forms the project coordinate Cross-sign.

relation_to_time_and_11d.rule: The double spiral can carry multiple typed state variables across successive sections without claiming that each visible ring is a literal physical dimension.
relation_to_time_and_11d.firewall: M-theory/11D physics remains a separate scientific comparator. This field is not evidence that human consciousness or Potatoverse theology is physically 11-dimensional.
relation_to_time_and_11d.scientific_bridge: The formal science layer may compare this geometry with complex-eigenvalue spirals, phase vortices, helical flows, compact-circle winding or holonomy, but each requires its own declared variables and mechanism.

minimum_view: at least three sampled rings per side
rendering_contract.accessibility: Every visual must have text explaining z, rho, theta, Mountain/Swamp distinction and the non-moral direction firewall.
rendering_contract.interaction: A frontend may allow layer count, phi scaling, chirality, aperture and terrain overlays to be toggled without changing canonical ownership.

section_ecology.rule: Sigma±n are sampled analytical sections through one continuous O-centered field. They are not stacked realms, moral ranks or permanent Room addresses. A Room, case or operator may project onto more than one section when the active question changes.
selection_axes: rho/radius = modeled horizon, differentiation or coupling scope
route = actual sequence of state changes
regime = Garden/Swamp/Forge/etc. only when its own tests are met

center.label: Σ0 · O / Plane
center.title: Operative present / common crossing
center.role: The waist where Axis and the canonical Plane meet. It is the best default place to ask what is actually present, what can cross, and what state-change is being attempted now.
route_questions: What is here now rather than remembered or anticipated?
What BEFORE and AFTER states would make this a real Door?
What guard, evidence, consent, capability or incorporation condition controls passage?
center.room_projection: Any Room may appear at Σ0 when its material is being evaluated in the current operative frame.
center.boundary: O is not the whole Door, whole World, whole present of the universe or a proof of spiritual status.

upper.label: Σ+1 · Incorporation
upper.title: First above-plane integration
upper.role: Near-waist section for newly incorporated states: a crossing has happened, but continuity, agency and consequence still need to stabilize.
route_questions: What changed after crossing?
Has the new state been incorporated into capability, rights, practice or relationship?
Can the result return to Plane/World without losing coherence?
upper.room_projection: Practice, ethics, theology, identity and system-design Rooms often project here when testing whether a claimed transition became durable.
upper.boundary: Higher z does not mean morally better; this section records integration work, not rank.

upper.label: Σ+2 · Branching
upper.title: Differentiation and capable branching
upper.role: A wider section where one integrated trunk can support several specialized branches without losing provenance to the common center.
route_questions: Which branches are genuinely distinct capabilities rather than duplicate labels?
What shared trunk/provenance still connects them?
Which branch produces testable Fruit?
upper.room_projection: The House can expose multiple Rooms here as sibling branches. The same Room may also project at other sections under a different question.
upper.boundary: Branch count or visual width is not evidence of truth, maturity or importance.

upper.label: Σ+3 · Garden
upper.title: Generative ecology
upper.role: Broad upper section for viable coexistence, cultivation, exchange, reproduction and Fruit across differentiated branches.
route_questions: Which relations increase independent future capacity?
What is being cultivated, pruned, repaired or reproduced?
What Fruit can descend back toward shared use?
upper.room_projection: Cross-Room collections and mature knowledge systems can be viewed here when their concern is generativity rather than ownership.
upper.boundary: Garden is a regime test, not a synonym for all upper geometry.

upper.label: Σ+4 · Mountain horizon
upper.title: Synthesis / compressed horizon
upper.role: Wide-horizon section paired with Mountain as a separate convergence overlay: many paths can be compared while criteria are compressed toward a coherent summit.
route_questions: What can be synthesized without erasing important differences?
Which criteria remain stable across wider scope?
What must descend again as usable Fruit, teaching, service or Seed?
upper.room_projection: High-level synthesis may span many Rooms here, but ownership remains with the underlying Rooms and specialist sources.
upper.boundary: Mountain convergence and spiral radius encode different variables; neither makes the section a supernatural altitude.

lower.label: Σ−1 · Embodiment / soil
lower.title: First below-plane consequence
lower.role: Near-waist section for embodiment, material consequence, burial, soil contact, unresolved residue and the first step of rooting.
route_questions: What concrete consequence followed from the current state?
Is descent becoming viable rooting, ordinary embodiment or loss of agency?
What remains connected to O/current structure?
lower.room_projection: Body, history, material culture, evidence and practice Rooms often project here when consequences rather than abstractions are foregrounded.
lower.boundary: Below is not automatically negative. Rooting and embodiment can be generative.

lower.label: Σ−2 · Roots
lower.title: Provenance / dependency network
lower.role: Wider lower section for sources, ancestry, dependencies, hidden support, retained memory and causal routes that still affect the current structure.
route_questions: Which prior sources or dependencies still feed or constrain the present?
What is live support versus dead residue?
Can the route back to a current claim or structure be traced?
lower.room_projection: History, source-authority, research and system Rooms project here when reconstructing provenance or dependency.
lower.boundary: Root is not the past itself, not memory by default and not Strife by default.

lower.label: Σ−3 · Swamp
lower.title: Recurrence / entanglement field
lower.role: Broad lower section for unresolved coupling, repeated roles, opacity, capture pressure and recurrence that may or may not still permit repair and exit.
route_questions: What is actually repeating?
Where is agency, correction, exit or reciprocity being reduced?
Which claims are sourced facts, allegations, interpretations or unresolved signals?
lower.room_projection: Subculture, attention, institutional, conflict and evidence Rooms may project here when the active object is recurrence or entanglement.
lower.boundary: Swamp is a diagnosed regime, not a label for people and not the whole lower field.

lower.label: Σ−4 · Deep basin
lower.title: Deep context / investigation / possible Forge contact
lower.role: Wide-depth section for difficult-to-resolve context, hidden dependencies and accumulated residue. Forge or Drain may intersect locally, but neither owns the whole section.
route_questions: What can still be verified at this depth?
Which uncertainties must remain unresolved?
What evidence or repair path can return material toward O rather than deepen capture?
lower.room_projection: Research, source-authority, history and repair/Forge views can project here while preserving claim status and provenance.
lower.boundary: Depth is not guilt, evil or certainty. Investigation must preserve evidence classes, counterevidence, appeal and return.

section_ecology.room_mapping_rule: Rooms are addressable semantic/evidence homes; sections are movable analytical cuts. A Room may be reached from several sections and a section may expose several Rooms. This is the intended non-Euclidean effect: navigation changes the projection without changing canonical ownership.
section_ecology.navigation_rule: Reader interfaces should permit selecting Σ0 or sampled Σ±n, then show role, overlays, questions and boundary. Selection changes the lens, not the underlying ontology.

operator_typing.primary_reading: The rendered double spiral is first a project geometry plus recurrence/state-displacement operator. It is not automatically a physical vortex, wave, holonomy or RG trajectory.

S_dyn.condition: Use only when a declared state has local rotation frequency omega and radial growth/decay rate sigma.
S_dyn.implication: For the exact recovered logarithmic spiral, b=sigma/omega. With b=2 ln(phi)/pi, a candidate focus model has sigma/omega=2 ln(phi)/pi.

S_hol.condition: Use only when a connection/transport rule and internal state are defined.
S_hol.meaning: A path may close in base coordinates while the transported internal state returns transformed.

S_phase.condition: Use only for a genuine phase variable/winding number.
S_phase.meaning: Phase winding is not equivalent to material rotation.

S_flow.condition: Use only for a declared velocity, current or energy-flow field.
S_flow.meaning: Helical/vortical flow is a physical transport model, not the default meaning of the House curve.

S_torus.condition: Use only when compact periodic coordinates are modeled.
S_torus.meaning: Rational winding closes; irrational winding can be quasiperiodic. Golden-ratio winding is an optional toy regime, not a canonical House law.

ring_spiral_holonomy_distinction.Ring: Comparable recurrence with negligible selected-state displacement.
ring_spiral_holonomy_distinction.Spiral: Recurrence with declared non-zero displacement in selected state variables.
ring_spiral_holonomy_distinction.Holonomy: Return to the same base point/path closure with a changed internal transported state.
ring_spiral_holonomy_distinction.rule: These may coincide in a particular model, but none implies the others.

operator_typing.fibonacci_boundary: phi enters the recovered golden/logarithmic project geometry as a scale ratio. The House does not claim Fibonacci dynamics causes all biological, social or physical spirals.
